items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was going to ask about some other places in the district, the Tuxedo Dance Hall. Did you ever play there? Tuxedo? [INTERVIEWEE] Tuxedo.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, they always did gamble, you know. They always, women always did gamble, shoot dice and everything else.
I was going to ask about some other places in the district, the Tuxedo Dance Hall. Did you ever play there? Tuxedo?
